svg.title: Felinaut brand board — conceptual reference
svg.desc: Original vector design reference, not an actual browser screenshot. Canonical astronaut-cat assets and all six current theme palettes. Current static compositions and future personality concepts are labeled separately.
svg.text: CONCEPTUAL REFERENCE · NOT A PRODUCT SCREENSHOT
A little curiosity. A whole universe.
A happy astronaut cat, a welcoming voice, and a soft spot for anything round and colorful.

svg.title: Felinaut — curiosity, in orbit
svg.desc: Felinaut is a happy female orange-and-cream tabby astronaut and curious explorer. She reaches a rounded padded paw toward a colorful cross-wound wool planet, while a second little yarn ball trails a thread toward her other paw. A round cyan bubble helmet frames visible ears, joyful crescent eyes and one open smile. Her white and lavender suit has a paw-and-star patch, rounded boots and a life-support pack; a striped tail, orbital threads and small stars complete the transparent illustration.

svg.text: She came for the stars. She stayed for the yarn.
Visible ears inside a cyan bubble helmet
White / lavender EVA suit · paw-star patch
One clear smile · two coherent paws

svg.title: Felinaut astronaut cat symbol
svg.desc: Felinaut, the happy female orange-and-cream explorer cat, has pointed ears and joyful crescent eyes inside a round cyan astronaut helmet. One open smile and a tiny tongue keep her face welcoming. A white and lavender rim and compact neck seal preserve the silhouette at small sizes. Original vector artwork on transparency.

svg.text: Offline vector composition · future concepts labeled · no remote artwork
